prompt_patterns.query_lane: Start by identifying the package-local query, contract, or interaction surface that owns the bug or drift. Map the narrowest lane-safe file set, keep public facades stable, and explain why this lane owns the fix.
prompt_patterns.codebase_analysis: Before editing, inspect the lane-owned code paths, verifier commands, and adjacent architecture docs. Summarize the likely failure mode, the narrowest safe change, and the verification signal that will prove the fix without widening scope.
